substrack.title: Substrack Privacy Policy
substrack.subtitle: Privacy information for the Substrack mobile app.
intro: Substrack is designed to work without an account, analytics, advertising, or selling personal data. The app helps you track subscriptions using information you enter on your device, and uses api.frankfurter.dev only to refresh exchange rates for currency conversion.

sections.title: Data You Enter
paragraphs: Subscription names, prices, billing dates, categories, notes, and notification preferences are stored locally on your device. We do not operate a server that receives or stores this subscription data. The only network request used for app functionality is a currency-rate request to api.frankfurter.dev, without your saved subscription details.

sections.title: How Data Is Stored
paragraphs: Your subscription data is stored locally on your device. Substrack requests exchange rates from api.frankfurter.dev so it can show totals in your selected display currency. Your saved subscription details are not sent with that request. The Frankfurter public API states that it does not collect personal data, but because the service is delivered through Cloudflare, Cloudflare may process basic technical request information such as IP address, timestamp, and request metadata. If the request fails, the app continues using its built-in default exchange rates.

sections.title: Analytics
paragraphs: The app does not include analytics, advertising trackers, or crash reporting SDKs. App activity is not used for advertising or user profiling.

sections.title: Authentication and Ads
paragraphs: The app does not include user authentication and does not show ads. We do not sell your data or share your subscription details with advertisers.

sections.title: Notifications
paragraphs: If you enable billing reminders, notification scheduling happens for the purpose of reminding you about upcoming renewals. You can turn notifications off in Settings at any time.

sections.title: Exporting Data
paragraphs: If you export your subscriptions, the exported file is created from the data stored on your device. You control where that file is saved or shared after export.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: The app is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This policy may be updated when app features or legal requirements change. The updated date above will reflect the latest version.

donit.title: Donit Privacy Policy
donit.subtitle: Privacy information for the Donit mobile app.
intro: Donit ("the app") is developed and maintained by Barış Gündüz. This privacy policy explains how the app handles your information.

sections.title: Data We Collect
paragraphs: Donit does not collect, transmit, or share any personal data. The app does not require an account, login, or internet connection to function.
All data you create in the app — tasks, streaks, history, and settings — is stored locally on your device using on-device storage. This data never leaves your device and is not accessible to us.

sections.title: In-App Purchases
paragraphs: Donit offers a one-time consumable in-app purchase (Streak Shield) processed through Apple's App Store. All payment and billing information is handled entirely by Apple. We do not receive, store, or process any payment details.

We use RevenueCat to verify and manage in-app purchase entitlements. RevenueCat may process a minimal set of anonymized purchase transaction data to fulfill this function. You can review RevenueCat's privacy policy at revenuecat.com/privacy.

sections.title: Analytics and Tracking
paragraphs: Donit does not use any analytics tools, crash reporting services, advertising SDKs, or tracking technologies. We do not track your usage of the app.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The only third-party service used by Donit is RevenueCat, solely for in-app purchase processing as described above.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Donit is rated 4+ and is suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect any information from children or anyone else.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: If this privacy policy changes, the updated version will be published at this URL with a revised date.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, contact us at baris@gunduzmedya.com.
